head: bd7b4b1c1ac010aa7a9afb49855d233161ca7670
rationale: No PG-207 security finding remains open at any severity (N-2 and N-3 closed, no new issue from 66d4dd835 or bd7b4b1c1). The verdict is FAIL only because the pnpm audit --audit-level=high gate exits 1 on pre-existing advisories outside the PG-207 diff, and this agent's rules have no exception for pre-existing findings (see b). The PG-207-attributable verdict is PASS.

gates.gate: gitleaks range origin/main..HEAD (sh .gitleaks/scan.sh range origin/main HEAD)

gates.notes: 39/39 (was 37). Includes new tests for N-3 (receiver trusted for another IMAP host does not act) and N-2 (parent domain of an SMTP host does not act). Log: gates/sec4-bounce.txt
64/64 across 2 files. Includes 429 -> RATE_LIMITED (oauth-mailbox.test.ts:161, :259). Log: gates/sec4-adapters.txt
12 vulnerabilities (1 low, 4 moderate, 7 high; 3 ignored). 0 mentions of nodemailer, imapflow or sanitize-html (the packages PG-207 adds). Same set as re-run 3. Log: gates/sec4-audit.txt
snyk: SNYK_TOKEN missing. semgrep/trivy not run (the two commits change two TS files, tests, a UI file and docs; no new file types). Documented, no waiver claimed.

gates.gate: Manual bypass probe (scratchpad/probe4.mjs, tsx on dsn-parser.ts source; withinHost/aligned/mayReportOn/trustedReceiver/trustedReceiversFromEnv copied verbatim from the new bounce-reader.ts)
gates.result: N-2 CLOSED, N-3 CLOSED, no new bypass
gates.notes: 11 routing cases + env-parser cases, see closed_since_previous_run

a_findings_introduced_by_pg207_still_ope.title: No public-suffix guard; safety rests on 'nobody can pass DKIM/SPF as a public suffix'
a_findings_introduced_by_pg207_still_ope.detail: Unchanged since re-run 3 and not touched by the two commits. A genuine verifier never reports a pass for header.d=co.uk (no DKIM key or SPF record exists at a public suffix), so this is defence-in-depth hardening, not a bypass. Optional fix: reject a passing domain that is a public suffix (psl/tldts). Not blocking on its own.

a_findings_introduced_by_pg207_still_ope.file: apps/api/src/modules/email/bounce-reader.ts:159-163 (From-address domain and recipient domain still use symmetric aligned())
a_findings_introduced_by_pg207_still_ope.title: From-address domain is still two-directional (a reporter that is a parent of the mailbox's From domain is entitled)
a_findings_introduced_by_pg207_still_ope.detail: This is documented design (the sending side's own domain) and only reachable when the From address sits on a subdomain of a shared platform whose parent domain passes SPF/DKIM for attacker-controlled mail, behind a trusted receiver. Not a regression, not the N-2 shape (hosts), and the ADR wording scopes 'no parent' to hosts. Recorded for completeness; no action required.

closed_since_previous_run.notes: bounce-reader.ts:104-107 withinHost() is one-directional and mayReportOn (:159-170) uses it for smtpHost/imapHost. Probes with trusted id and host smtp.sendgrid.net: reporter sendgrid.net via smtp.mailfrom (R) and via dkim header.d (R2): ACT=false; sibling other.sendgrid.net: false; lookalike notsmtp.sendgrid.net: false (dot-anchored suffix); host itself and a.smtp.sendgrid.net: true (intended). New test bounce-reader.test.ts parent-of-host case passes; the probe confirms it fails for the right reason (parser yields reporter platform.example.net, entitlement refuses it), not because the header is unparsed.

bounce-reader.ts:122-139 trustedReceiver() now requires an exact (imapHost, authservId) pair for the mailbox's own lower-cased imapHost; imapHost null fails closed. Probes: id trusted for imap.acme.com is refused for a mailbox on imap.other.com (T1), accepted for imap.acme.com (T2); mx.google.com listed for imap.gmail.com is not honoured on mail.self.example.invalid (T5, the previous probe U shape); a mailbox host with upper case or trailing dot fails closed (T3). trustedReceiversFromEnv (:710-724): entries without exactly one '=' or with an empty side are dropped ('a=b=c', 'a=', '=b', bare id), so a malformed entry cannot widen trust; env value and report are lower-cased symmetrically. Runner ruling to keep the variable empty is consistent with the fail-closed default. Test 'a receiver trusted for one customer's IMAP host is not trusted for another mailbox (N-3)' passes.

oauth-mailbox.ts tokenErrorCode(): 429 -> RATE_LIMITED, 5xx -> CONNECT_FAILED, invalid_grant -> TOKEN_REVOKED, else AUTH_FAILED. Codes only, no provider body or token is carried into the error (unchanged). A transient provider outage no longer marks a mailbox broken (availability improvement). The residual that AUTH_FAILED after rotation leaves the mailbox ACTIVE is tracked as #971; it is a correctness/availability item, not a confidentiality or integrity hole.

closed_since_previous_run.id: bd7b4b1c1 UI fix (MyMailboxCard.tsx, SMTP re-setup after disconnect)
closed_since_previous_run.notes: 3-line component change plus test; no new input sink, no secret handling change.
Placeholder hosts only (example.invalid style); gitleaks range clean. Runbook now states the pair format and that trust is never global, matching the code.

b_pre_existing_not_introduced_by_pg207.item: pnpm audit highs: follow-redirects x2 (apps/web > @scalar), vite via launch-editor (root), markdown-it (via markdownlint-cli); 12 total, 7 high
b_pre_existing_not_introduced_by_pg207.rule: stoa-security agent 'Verdict Logic': 'Any gate exits non-zero -> FAIL' (pnpm audit --audit-level=high exits 1) and 'HIGH -> FAIL, requires fix before completion'. The rules make no exception for pre-existing findings.
b_pre_existing_not_introduced_by_pg207.notes: Re-verified at bd7b4b1c1: the audit output has zero mentions of nodemailer, imapflow or sanitize-html, and the two commits since re-run 3 touch no package.json or lockfile. Resolution is a dependency bump on main or an ADR accepting the risk, outside the PG-207 diff, or an owner call to treat them as not blocking this task (OD-3).

c_owner_decisions.title: Accept the provider-header trust assumptions or require the #965 live header spike first
c_owner_decisions.notes: Unchanged. The design trusts that Gmail always prepends mx.google.com and Microsoft always stamps its no-authserv-id Authentication-Results on top. Documented provider behaviour, not verified live (#965).

c_owner_decisions.title: Provider backscatter
c_owner_decisions.notes: Unchanged. A genuine DKIM-signed DSN from the provider about mail an attacker crafted with our record ids is authentic and entitled by design. Not fixable in code; accepted-risk class for the ADR.

c_owner_decisions.title: Pre-existing pnpm audit highs: bump on main, ADR acceptance, or treat as non-blocking for PG-207
c_owner_decisions.notes: This is the only thing keeping the STOA at FAIL. The STOA cannot waive it by its own rules; the owner or the runner must record the decision.

c_owner_decisions.title: Open issues #970 (Exchange NDR senders record-only) and #971 (AUTH_FAILED after OAuth rotation leaves mailbox ACTIVE)
c_owner_decisions.notes: Both are fail-safe or availability items, not security bypasses. #970 means some genuine bounces are recorded but do not act; #971 means a broken mailbox is not auto-flagged. No confidentiality or integrity impact found; accepting them as follow-ups is an owner decision.

summary: FAIL on the pre-existing pnpm audit highs only. At HEAD bd7b4b1c1: gitleaks clean (exit 0); bounce-reader 39/39, adapters dsn-parser + oauth-mailbox 64/64. N-2 (LOW) and N-3 (MEDIUM) are closed by code and test and confirmed by a re-run probe; no new issue from the two commits. Remaining PG-207 items: H-1 optional hardening (LOW) and an informational note. Owner decisions: OD-1 provider-header assumptions (#965), OD-2 backscatter, OD-3 audit highs, OD-4 issues #970/#971.
